messages:
Marta (FinOps): Need a concise 1-week GPU-hours sample broken down by customer/project for an audit. Include reserved vs burst attribution notes. Deadline: EOD tomorrow. cc @Kevin (Infra) @Sasha (ML Eng)
Kevin (Infra): I can query billing.gpu_usage_metrics. Do you want attribution by billing_label or by owner from k8s_job_labels? Many ephemeral jobs lack k8s labels.
Sasha (ML Eng): We stamp request.customer_id on inference, but notebooks and ad-hoc jobs are often missing. Suggest primary by request.customer_id, fallback to job labels, final bucket as "internal/experiment".
Marta (FinOps): Good. Include counts and percent of rows that used the fallback and percent untagged.
Kevin (Infra): Draft SQL (short):
```sql
SELECT COALESCE(m.request_customer_id, j.customer_id, 'internal/experiment') AS customer_id,
  SUM(m.gpu_hours) AS gpu_hours,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.capacity_tag = 'reserved' THEN m.gpu_hours ELSE 0 END) AS reserved_hours,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.capacity_tag = 'burst' THEN m.gpu_hours ELSE 0 END) AS burst_hours,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.instance_id) AS node_count
FROM `billing.gpu_usage_metrics` m
LEFT JOIN `infra.k8s_job_labels` j ON m.job_id = j.job_id
WHERE m.usage_start >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY gpu_hours DESC
LIMIT 500;
```
Kevin (Infra): I'll include a flag for rows where request_customer_id IS NULL to estimate fallback use.
Ryan (Billing): Note: for invoices we must not double-charge dedicated hours. If you find customer_id NULL but capacity_tag='dedicated', flag for manual review.
billing-bot: Alert: daily sweep found 18 untagged GPU instances in eu-central-1. Details: https://internal.redwood/gpu-sweep/1842129876 :warning:
Sasha (ML Eng): I'll backfill notebook tags for my team for the past 7 days where I can. Also found one long-running job used by multiple customers. Will propose a split.
Marta (FinOps): For shared jobs, allocate proportionally by request_count for this sample. That approved?
Ryan (Billing): Approve proportional-by-request_count for the audit sample only. We'll review if this becomes permanent.
Kevin (Infra): Running query now. ETA ~30-40m. I will upload CSV + short README explaining join logic and reserved/burst rules.
Sasha (ML Eng): Backfill started. Expect to recover ~60% of my untagged notebook hours. Will post list of remaining untagged runs.
Kevin (Infra): Uploaded: https://internal.redwood/files/1842129876-gpu-week-sample.csv. Summary in README: ~7.8% GPU-hours untagged; top 3 customers = 70% of sample; reserved/burst tagged by capacity_tag mapping.
Marta (FinOps): Great, I'll draft the audit summary and share with customer-ops and the audit team. If anyone spots anomalies in the CSV ping me directly. :thumbsup:
